$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Hang Reports row (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: hangReports
lists.note: Settings > Privacy and Security > Hang Reports, with the View Hang Report button at the end of the category (SettingsSchema.actions(in: .home)).

rows.note: Whether this Mac sends opt-in hang reports (plans/cmux-next/hang-reports-DESIGN.md). Off: nothing is sent until the person turns it on; only NIGHTLY builds send. Agents may not change it (AgentRefusal.privacy).

help.text: Nightly builds send daily hang stacks and timings, never your files, URLs or text.

summary.text: Nightly only. No file names, text or addresses.

lists.name: usagePatterns
lists.note: Settings > Privacy and Security > Usage Patterns: opt-in local counters of how the person uses cmux (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-usage-patterns). Leo 2026-11-07: "could we opt in to tracking usage patterns? at least for myself". Off by default; nothing leaves the machine.

rows.note: Whether the daemons on this machine count how cmux is used: commands and operations by name, split directions, connections, agent chats per harness, prompts, tokens, distinct paired machines, by day and hour, and the registry names of packages agents' shell calls install (acpmux hub/tool_installs.rs; the Cloud image's package list is chosen from them). Counts and identifiers only, never prompts, terminal text, addresses, file paths or names. Stored locally; `cmux usage-patterns` and the Agent Stats page show them. Agents may not change it (privacy).

help.text: Counts how you use cmux on this Mac. Nothing you type is recorded; nothing is sent.

summary.text: Stays on this computer. Counts only, no text.

rows.note: Leo 2026-11-05: "Like just an option in settings, like, Hey, you can do this to improve CMux". Whether this Mac and the person's Cloud machines send cmux the registry names and counts of packages agents' shell calls install (acpmux install_share.rs; cmux-platform /v1/install-counts), so the Cloud image bake pre-downloads the common ones. Off by default; a Cloud machine asks the platform for the person's choice, and the platform reports it to the person's Cloud machines as `usage_sharing` on the status report reply (cmux-platform installcounts/SharingReply.ts), which also gates their image additions list (cmux-host cloud/additions.rs). The row's help is its consent text: the settings page shows it with Turn On and Cancel before writing true (webviews settings/components/ConsentPrompt.tsx). Never prompts, commands, paths, project names or identity. Agents may not change it (privacy).

title.text: Share Package Installs to Improve cmux

help.text: Sends cmux the names of packages agents install and of tools you add to your Cloud machines, so new Cloud machines come with the common ones already downloaded. Names and counts only, never prompts, commands, file or project names, or anything that identifies you. Turning it off deletes your tool list.
